key.name: layout-json
key.description: Stores widget types, sizes, and desktop positions as JSON.

key.name: language
key.description: 'auto' follows the session language; otherwise a code with a translation in locale/, e.g. 'uk' or 'en'.

key.name: first-day-of-week
key.summary: First day of the calendar week
key.description: 'auto' uses Monday for Ukrainian and the session locale otherwise.

key.name: show-panel-button
key.description: The button holds edit mode and adding widgets; turn it back on to change the layout.

key.name: panel-weather
key.summary: Show the weather in the top bar
key.description: A symbolic icon and the temperature, hidden while there is no data.

key.name: panel-weather-position
key.summary: Top bar side for the weather
key.description: Left goes after Activities, center before the clock, right before the system items.

key.name: calendar-show-events
key.description: Mark days with events and list upcoming events on wide calendars. Uses the same calendars as the top bar.

key.name: alerts-region-id
key.description: ukrainealarm region id (oblast, district or community). Alerts in its parent oblast and its communities also count.

key.name: alerts-notify
key.description: Show a notification when an alert starts or ends in the selected region.

key.name: outage-provider
key.description: Data file name in yaroslav2901/OE_OUTAGE_DATA, e.g. 'Khmelnytskoblenerho'.
